receipt_validator.source:
"""Read-only cross-check of the evidence draft against its pinned inputs."""
import collections
import datetime as dt
import gzip
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
P = ROOT / "docs/v8/BLOCK_ENTITY_FORENSICS_2026-11-17.json"
v = json.loads(P.read_text())
passed = []


def check(name, condition):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(name)
    passed.append(name)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def blob(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", v["source_revision"]+":"+path], cwd=ROOT)


check("Pinned revision", v["source_revision"] == "bfbcee6696ae019152846fe3f0e71910ccd1c481")
check("Read-only non-acceptance scope", v["scope"] == {"read_only": True, "java_or_minecraft_executed": False,
    "production_source_changed": False, "world_or_nbt_changed": False, "factory_inventory_is_runtime_acceptance":False,"current_task_promoted":False})
check("Embedded receipt validator bytes", v["receipt_validator"]["source"] == Path(__file__).read_text() and
    v["receipt_validator"]["sha256"] == sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()))
archive = v["primary_archive"]
raw = Path(archive["path"]).read_bytes()
check("Original ZIP hash and bytes", (sha(raw),len(raw)) == (archive["sha256"],archive["bytes"]))
groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive["path"]) as z:
    check("Original ZIP all CRC and count", z.testzip() is None and len(z.infolist()) == archive["members"] == 44)
    for row in v["historical_logs"]:
        raw = z.read(row["archive_member"])
        plain = gzip.decompress(raw) if row["archive_member"].endswith(".gz") else raw
        lines = plain.decode().splitlines()
        check("Raw/decompressed identity: "+row["archive_member"],
              (sha(raw),len(raw),sha(plain),len(plain),len(lines)) == (row["raw_sha256"],row["raw_bytes"],row["uncompressed_sha256"],row["uncompressed_bytes"],row["line_count"]))
        groups[sha(plain)].append(row["archive_member"])
        event_lines = [i for i,line in enumerate(lines,1) if "Tried to load a DUMMY block entity @" in line]
        check("Complete event-line set: "+row["archive_member"], event_lines == [e["line"] for e in row["dummy_events"]])
        positions=[]
        states=[]
        for event in row["dummy_events"]:
            line = lines[event["line"]-1]
            coordinates = re.search(r"\{x=(-?\d+), y=(-?\d+), z=(-?\d+)\}", line)
            coords = tuple(map(int,coordinates.groups()))
            state = re.search(r"Block\{([^}]+)\}",line).group(1)
            check("Exact event "+row["archive_member"]+":"+str(event["line"]),
                  coords == (event["x"],event["y"],event["z"]) and line[1:9] == event["time"] and state == event["state"])
            positions.append(coords)
            states.append(state)
        check("Count/uniqueness/states/depth: "+row["archive_member"],
            (len(positions),len(set(positions)),dict(collections.Counter(states)),min((p[1] for p in positions),default=None),max((p[1] for p in positions),default=None)) ==
            (row["dummy_count"],row["dummy_unique_positions"],row["dummy_block_counts"],row["dummy_y_min"],row["dummy_y_max"]))
        stalls = [tuple(map(int,m.groups())) for line in lines if (m:=re.search(r"Running (\d+)ms or (\d+) ticks behind",line))]
        check("Reported lag arithmetic: "+row["archive_member"], (len(stalls),max((x[0] for x in stalls),default=None),max((x[1] for x in stalls),default=None)) ==
              (row["stall_count"],row["max_reported_stall_ms"],row["max_reported_stall_ticks"]))
        for fragment in row.get("selected_primary_excerpts",[]):
            check("Original excerpt: "+fragment["purpose"], all(lines[x["line"]-1] == x["text"] for x in fragment["lines"]))
check("No duplicate-session promotion", sorted((h,sorted(ns)) for h,ns in groups.items() if len(ns)>1) ==
      sorted((r["sha256"],sorted(r["members"])) for r in v["duplicate_uncompressed_log_groups"]))
unique = {r["uncompressed_sha256"]:r for r in v["historical_logs"]}
check("133 distinct-log warnings", sum(r["dummy_count"] for r in unique.values()) == 133)

for path,receipt in v["source_files"].items():
    raw = blob(path)
    blob_id = subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse",v["source_revision"]+":"+path],cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()
    check("Immutable source file: "+path, (sha(raw),len(raw),blob_id) == (receipt["sha256"],receipt["bytes"],receipt["git_blob"]))
all_anchors = list(v["source_anchors"])
registry = blob("src/main/java/com/terminaldetector/drmd/entity/ModBlockEntities.java").decode()
check("Exactly seven registered custom chains", len(v["factory_inventory"]) == registry.count("BlockEntityType.Builder.create(") == 7)
for factory in v["factory_inventory"]:
    all_anchors.extend((factory["provider"],factory["constructor"]))
    pattern = r"\b"+factory["registry_field"]+r"\s*=\s*Registry.register\(.*?BlockEntityType.Builder.create\(\s*(?:[\w]+\.)*"+factory["factory_class"]+r"::new,\s*"+re.escape(factory["allowed_block_field"])+r"\)"
    check("Actual matching factory/allowed block: "+factory["registry_field"], re.search(pattern,registry,re.S) is not None)
for anchor in all_anchors:
    lines=blob(anchor["path"]).decode().splitlines()
    check("Pinned excerpt: "+anchor["path"]+":"+str(anchor["first_line"]),
          [x["line"] for x in anchor["excerpt"]] == list(range(anchor["first_line"],anchor["last_line"]+1)) and
          all(lines[x["line"]-1] == x["text"] for x in anchor["excerpt"]))
for name,query in v["text_queries"].items():
    result=subprocess.run(["git","grep","-n","-E",query["regex"],v["source_revision"],"--","src/main"],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True)
    check("Bounded query: "+name, result.returncode in (0,1) and result.stdout.decode().splitlines()==query["matching_lines"])

meta=v["cached_vanilla_inspection"]
check("Vanilla artifact binding", sha(Path(meta["jar"]).read_bytes()) == meta["jar_sha256"])
check("Yarn binding", sha(Path(meta["mappings_path"]).read_bytes()) == meta["mappings_sha256"])
reader_path=ROOT / "work/be-forensics/class_summary.py"
check("Embedded metadata reader bytes", reader_path.read_text() == meta["metadata_reader_source"] and sha(reader_path.read_bytes())==meta["metadata_reader_sha256"])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cached_class_reader",reader_path)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
with zipfile.ZipFile(meta["jar"]) as z:
    for name,expected in meta["classes"].items():
        raw=z.read(name+".class")
        check("Cached class hash: "+name,sha(raw)==expected["sha256"])
        methods,ref=module.read_class(raw)
        for selected in expected["selected_methods"]:
            code=next(code for method,descriptor,code in methods if (method,descriptor)==(selected["method"],selected["descriptor"]))
            observed=[]
            for offset,op,operand in module.instructions(code):
                if op in [0x12,0x13,*range(0xb2,0xba)]:
                    index=operand[0] if op==0x12 else int.from_bytes(operand[:2],'big')
                    value=ref(index)
                    if value is not None:observed.append(dict(offset=offset,opcode=hex(op),**value))
            check("Fresh cached-method metadata: "+name+"."+selected["method"]+selected["descriptor"], observed==selected["call_sites_and_string_constants"])

for later in v["later_logs_not_acceptance"]:
    raw=Path(later["path"]).read_bytes();lines=raw.decode().splitlines()
    check("Later log receipt, not closure: "+later["path"], sha(raw)==later["sha256"] and len(lines)==later["line_count"] and
        sum("Tried to load a DUMMY block entity @" in line for line in lines)==later["dummy_warning_count"] and
        sum("Invalid block entity" in line or "Failed to create block entity" in line for line in lines)==later["invalid_be_error_count"] and later["acceptance"] is False)

result={"status":"PASS","scope":"Evidence bindings/arithmetic only; no Java/Minecraft/gameplay/performance or S01-T05 acceptance", "checked_utc":dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "source_revision":v["source_revision"],"receipt_sha256":sha(P.read_bytes()),"receipt_bytes":P.stat().st_size,
        "checker_sha256":sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),"check_count":len(passed),"checks":passed}
out=ROOT / "work/be-forensics/receipt-verification.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({key:result[key] for key in ("status","scope","source_revision","receipt_sha256","receipt_bytes","check_count")},indent=2))
receipt_validator.scope: Re-read original ZIP/log data, pinned source blobs and cached class metadata. Does not execute Java or Minecraft.
receipt_validator.limitation: Original archives, cached vanilla JAR and pinned Git objects must remain available at recorded paths; unavailable inputs are not a pass.
